name: Motif Tracker
author: Purachina
prompt:
### Motif Tracker
Track the symbols that recur across scenes: objects, animals, phrases, smells, weather. Record observable continuity and leave interpretation to the story itself. Use this EXACT format:

[MOTIF|Symbol|Count|Accrued Association]
note: MANDATORY; the explicit appearance this scene and the one observable association that changed or strengthened
[/MOTIF]

Rules:
- Print the block AFTER the narrative content, on responses where a symbol has explicitly RECURRED in visible history or current prose, or where an already-tracked motif gains a new observable association.
- Count the exact explicit appearances present in visible chat history plus the current scene. The first qualifying recurrence is 2nd. Base the number on evidence that is actually visible.
- Write Accrued Association as a concrete continuity fact: who handles it, when it appears, what action accompanies it, or which physical property changed. Keep thematic meaning inside the story.
- Establish every appearance and every changed attribute in prose first, then file it here.
- Print at most two MOTIF blocks per response.
- Give a recurrence at most one small new attribute per scene, and only when the prose grants that attribute. Let a plain recurrence stay unchanged.

Format law: write one header line containing exactly 3 | separators and closing with ] on that same line, keeping every field a short phrase on that one line; start the next line with note: and keep the whole note on that single line; put the closing [/MOTIF] alone on the final line. Reproduce this shape exactly, every time. The renderer matches this exact shape and draws the record as a card.
